Description

Located in the RIBA award winning Mission development, this beautifully renovated one-bedroom apartment offers stylish, contemporary living in one of East London’s most vibrant and well connected neighbourhoods. Set in the historic grounds of St Mary of Eton Church, the development also benefits from a welcoming community café, creating a unique and peaceful setting close to the area’s diverse cafes and bars, all within just a few minutes' walk from Victoria Park.

Finished to a high standard throughout, the property boasts a bright and spacious reception room with ample space for both living and dining. Large windows allow plenty of natural light, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere.

The modern fitted kitchen has been thoughtfully designed with a range of contemporary wall and base units, generous worktop space, and integrated appliance space, providing both practicality and style.

The spacious double bedroom offers comfortable accommodation with bespoke fitted wardrobes offering plenty of storage, while the contemporary bathroom is spacious and has been finished with modern sanitary ware and quality tiling.

This superb apartment would be ideal for a professional individual or couple looking to enjoy excellent transport connections whilst being moments from Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, Victoria Park, and Hackney Wick's thriving café, restaurant, and creative scene.

The property also benefits from a secure entry system and a lift.

Early viewing is highly recommended.

Property History & Area

The Mission Development at St Mary of Eton Church forms part of the continued regeneration surrounding Hackney Wick and Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park. Since the London 2012 Olympic Games, the area has become one of East London's most desirable residential locations, blending modern developments with Hackney's industrial heritage.

The neighbourhood is renowned for its canalside walks, independent cafés, creative studios, riverside restaurants and outstanding green spaces. Stratford, Here East and Westfield Stratford City are all within easy reach, offering world-class shopping, leisure and entertainment facilities.

The area continues to attract professionals working in the City, Canary Wharf and Stratford due to its exceptional transport links and vibrant lifestyle.

Local Authority Band C (Hackney Council)

Vergers Apartments enjoys an enviable position in the heart of Hackney Wick, one of East London's most exciting neighbourhoods. Residents benefit from immediate access to Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, Victoria Park, Here East and Westfield Stratford City, together with an excellent selection of independent cafés, restaurants, gyms and cultural venues. Outstanding transport connections provide quick access to the City, Canary Wharf, Stratford and the West End.
